items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: And this is Bill Buford. On tuba? One of the most marvelous tuba players I've ever heard.

ctx.x: Let's see, Sutler, I'll make just for the record here, is on the left. The trumpet player on the left facing the... Yeah, uh-huh.
And this is Bill Buford. On tuba? One of the most marvelous tuba players I've ever heard.
Oh yes, he's been on other records too. The trombonist?
